scope: Official and institutional hiking sources for the 16 Sierra Magina municipalities

sources.authority: Junta de Andalucia - Ventana del Visitante
sources.finding: Official Parque Natural Sierra Magina senderos and downloadable route resources.

sources.authority: Diputacion de Jaen - Jaen Paraiso Interior
sources.finding: Official Sierra Magina tourism network; confirms the 16-municipality scope and publishes R1-R9 hiking network plus territorial resources.
Lists Navalcan-Molinos, Navalcan-Los Castillejos-Pinturas rupestres, Canada del Toril and Noalejo-Navalcan.
Lists Carchelejo-Cazalla-Convento, Carchel-Carchelejo por Barranco de la Parrilla and ascent to Cueva del Puerto de las Palomas.

sources.authority: Ayuntamiento de Mancha Real - Turismo Mancha Real
sources.finding: Publishes three Level 2 hiking routes around Pena del Aguila with downloadable resources.

sources.authority: Ayuntamiento de La Guardia de Jaen
sources.finding: Describes the Cerrillo de San Cristobal-Cueva Cabrera-Allanadas del Santo route.
Confirms a didactic botanical trail at Desfiladero de Puerta Arenas; technical track remains to be located.

sources.authority: Diputacion de Jaen - Jaen Paraiso Interior
sources.finding: Documents Puente de Tierra hiking variants: approximately 17 km circular or 12 km out-and-back.

sources.authority: Ayuntamiento de Larva / Jaen Paraiso Interior
sources.finding: Municipality audited. Natural areas suitable for walking are documented, but no named official pedestrian route with a dedicated technical sheet/track was located. Do not invent one.
